regions.full_page: God bless you and all. Thanks be to the Good God for all things. His ways like all His works are so deep, so divine. I just read your interesting communication, which for some time I have been more or less expecting - possibly with a tinge of a gentle ear-pull at your not having recently heard / Br'klin. Thank God again for yourself and Fr. Maurice J's good health and for whatever His great plans may materialize for us in the near and distant future - always planning for our best - " .. if we only don't spoil His plans by ours" . Well, I am sure you will be pleased to know that I did finally wake up and take at least some steps toward your seeing Bishop Molloy. I had a very nice little visit with his auxeliary last Friday, Bishop Carney. He seems to be quite a modest, friendly, young Prelate and showed a decided interest in your work for religious schools in the Philippines. I had heard before that it is not too easy to see His Excellency Bishop Molloy and therefore, it did not surprise me when / intimated something to that effect. However, he seemed promising and pleased when I suggested that with his coaching us just a little that difficulty could probably be minimized. This especially since he had assured me that he himself is there in the Chancery practically every day. Your coming in May or June therefore would probably be oppor- tune. For that matter he did not make any suggestions when we should come, except that he said he would be away the week of April 11th, since he is expected in Milwaukee for the Consecration of a new Bishop. I did not ask him but I understand its to be Msgr. Meyers - new Bishop of Superior.
